selection.name: 金鸡湖西岸：星港街／苏惠路与南段湖滨步道
selection.areaMethod: Spherical rectangle: R^2 * radians(east-west) * (sin(north)-sin(south)); R=6371008.8 metres. Includes lake water; not a claim of 0.845 km2 dry land.

source.preservation: The ignored atomic cache retains the complete original response, all coordinates, node tags, full ways, and recursively acquired relation members. Listed way tags below are verbatim; missing keys remain missing.

investigation.result: Search window only (about 4.65 km2). Narrowed to the connected Suhui/Xinggang ground-road junction and mapped sidewalk loop, with a separate contiguous lake walk component.

Southern inspection: crossing way/848683740 has dangling ends node/7918730694 and node/7918730697, with no sourced side-route memberships. Not used. The complete sidewalk/crossing loop way/935142617 through way/935142629 is used instead.

Northern inspection within the original source window: way/848683742 and way/896314419 each lack a connected south-side path. way/848683749 connects a designated walking cycleway to way/848683750, but that path ends after about 10 m and does not establish a lake connection. The Xinggang/Sumu approaches also carry via-way restrictions. No connectors were synthesized; this alternative was not selected.

selectionRules.nodeIds: Ordered contiguous source subsequences, not compiled routes. Most are complete ways. Never connect ways just because their projected lines intersect.
selectionRules.clipping: The final source segment on way/466930064 and first on way/790754548 extend slightly west of the district. Task 2 must geometrically clip these existing segments to bounds, not stop vehicles on a crossing node or copy the entire external way.
selectionRules.driving: Only the ten listed primary-way subsequences; all have oneway=yes. Task 2 adds same-cache way/834477631 to continue the through-only northbound lane to an off-centre exit. Preserve source direction and turn:lanes. No pedestrian permission is inferred from primary roads.
selectionRules.walking: Only the fourteen listed footway subsequences, in two intentionally separate components. No inferred roadside sidewalks or connection between the junction and lake.
selectionRules.layer: All selected ways lack bridge, tunnel, cutting and layer tags; interpret as common layer 0 for topology, not as measured elevation.
selectionRules.access: No selected way or selected node has an access/vehicle/motor_vehicle/foot prohibition. Missing access tags are not rewritten to access=yes.
selectionRules.dimensions: No selected width or maxspeed exists. Task 2 must record conservative width/speed assumptions and validate envelopes before publishing. This file does not assign them.

junction.name: 星港街／苏惠路
junction.evidence: Source node/4227521259 is internal to both ground-level ways: southbound Xinggang way/935142611 and eastbound Suhui way/893261890. Their four incident source segments establish an actual planar conflict junction, not a projected bridge/tunnel intersection.
junction.turnStatus: Source topology only. No lane-level turns, swept envelopes, conflict zones, or route capacity have been compiled.

lakePath.evidence: One unbroken 16-node highway=footway subsequence on the west side of the lake polygon. Ends before the bridge way/838960247 and before the southern district boundary.
